components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold pill for placing, saving, and continuing on the atlas.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--gold); color: var(--sky-deep); font-family: var(--font-body, Barlow, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, var(--gold)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline pill for cancel and secondary slip actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 16%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-body, Barlow, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, var(--gold)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Copper pill for deleting a star.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--danger); color: var(--sky-deep); font-family: var(--font-body, Barlow, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, var(--gold)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Round catalog chips for living, gender, and tag filters.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: var(--font-body, Barlow, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 14%, transparent); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold) 55%, transparent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, var(--gold)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip-on { background: var(--gold); color: var(--sky-deep); border-color: var(--gold); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 16px-corner field with an ink hairline and gold caret.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-body, Barlow, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 14%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sky) 40%, transparent); color: var(--ink); padding: 8px 12px; font-family: var(--font-body, Barlow, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; caret-color: var(--gold); outline: none; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold) 40%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, var(--gold)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Instrument Tool
components.description: 40px round gold glyph hits in the glass instrument rail.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 28px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.02)), var(--glass); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18), 0 18px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.28); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.35); } .ds-tool { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--gold); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold) 22%, transparent); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, var(--gold)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tool:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Portrait-star
components.description: Circular person disk with a gold catalog rim; initials when no portrait.
components.css: .ds-star { width: 84px; height: 84px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.28), 0 0 0 1.5px var(--gold); } .ds-star:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-star:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, var(--gold)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-star[aria-pressed="true"], .ds-star:active { box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgb(210 170 118 / 0.32), 0 0 0 2px var(--gold); } .ds-star-face { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--panel); color: var(--gold); font-family: var(--font-catalog, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); font-size: 32px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Compass Action
components.description: Gold cardinal disk for adding parent, child, sibling, or spouse.
components.css: .ds-compass { width: 48px; height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--gold); color: var(--sky-deep); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.28); cursor: pointer; } .ds-compass:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-compass:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bone); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-compass:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-compass-plus { font-family: var(--font-catalog, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-compass-label { font-family: var(--font-catalog, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.css: .ds-slip { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 260px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 28px; color: var(--ink); text-align: center; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.02)), var(--glass); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18), 0 18px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.28); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.35); } .ds-slip-star { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--gold); font-family: var(--font-catalog, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); font-size: 36px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgb(210 170 118 / 0.32), 0 0 0 2px var(--gold); } .ds-slip-name { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-catalog, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bone); } .ds-slip-year { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-catalog, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--gold); } .ds-slip-bio { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-bio, "Source Serif 4", serif); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-slip-k { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-catalog, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); } .ds-slip-v { margin: 2px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-body, Barlow, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; }

narrative.overview:
The family is a night sky you navigate. People are portrait-stars; kinship is the constellation you draw by selecting a star and adding at the compass. The product is the atlas, not a database dressed as a page: the canvas is full-bleed ink-navy, instruments float as glass chrome, and a selected life opens as a catalog slip rather than a form stack.

Materials are specific. The sky is a deep navy field with a faint starfield and gold generation arcs. Portrait-stars wear a thin gold rim. Names are bone-white condensed inscriptions. Biography is the one serif voice, set as a short catalog note. Glass panels sit on the sky with blur, a hairline light edge, and an inset highlight — instrument chrome, not cards on cream.

The system refuses parchment genealogy, cream family-book cards, rectangular person tiles, and form-first CRUD. A day-chart theme exists as a mapped inversion of the same tokens (cool steel sky, deeper bronze gold, ink-dark inscriptions), not as a second, paper world.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed atlas canvas with faint gold generation graticule and circular portrait-stars
Gold used as catalog metal: rims, years, compass, primary actions — never as a large fill
Barlow Condensed for names, wordmark, and field labels; Barlow for UI; Source Serif 4 for biography only
Glass instrument column left, catalog slip right, compass add around the selected star
Depth from glass, gold rings, and starfield — not from stacked white cards

rules.name: The Night Canvas Rule
rules.body: The sky is the page. Cream boards, paper genealogy, and dashboard wells never replace the atlas.

rules.name: The Gold Rim Rule
rules.body: Gold is catalog metal on ≤ the rims, years, labels, compass, and primary pills. If a layout needs a large filled plane, it is sky, glass, or panel — not gold.

rules.name: The Catalog Inscription Rule
rules.body: Names, years, generation marks, and the wordmark use Barlow Condensed. Body stays Barlow. Biography is the only serif. Do not uppercase body or bio.

rules.name: The Glass Over Sky Rule
rules.body: Chrome, slips, and dialogs are glass on the atlas. Do not introduce a white card layer to create hierarchy.

rules.name: The Compass Add Rule
rules.body: New kin are placed from the selected star’s cardinals. A form may complete the person; it does not replace the compass as the way into adding.

dos: Do set new screens on ink navy with glass chrome and gold used as rim, type metal, and pill — not as wallpaper.
Do represent people as circular portrait-stars with a 1.5–2px gold ring and condensed uppercase names.
Do add relatives from the four compass actions on the selected star.
Do set biography in Source Serif 4 at 15px and keep UI copy in Barlow.
Do keep generation structure visible as faint gold arcs with Roman labels on the atlas.
donts: Don't rebuild the tree as cream genealogy cards, parchment, tables, or rectangular avatar tiles.
Don't open a form-first add flow when a star is selected; the compass is the add.
Don't set body paragraphs or bio in Barlow Condensed, and don't uppercase running text.
Don't fill large regions with gold or constellation blue; those colors are line, rim, and small controls.
Don't introduce a white or cream card layer to solve hierarchy — use glass over sky, or dim the unused stars.
